name: ExoWork Onboarding
description: Turn a messy call transcript into a structured action plan — and learn ExoWork along the way

phases.name: Bring Your Context
phases.description: Give ExoWork something real to work with

steps.name: Upload a call transcript or document
steps.description: Upload a meeting transcript, call recording notes, or any document you want to extract action items from. If you don't have one handy, there's a sample transcript in the samples folder — download and upload it here.

steps.name: Have the agent read your document
steps.description: The agent will read what you uploaded and give you a quick summary — this is how ExoWork starts most tasks
steps.command: Read the file(s) the user has uploaded in the uploads/ folder. Give a concise summary: who was involved, what was discussed, and what the key topics were. Keep it to 3-5 bullet points. Then ask if the summary captures it correctly or if anything important is missing.

phases.name: Create and Deliver
phases.description: Generate the action plan, review it, and push to ClickUp
phases.completionCta: Run again with a different document

steps.name: Generate the action plan
steps.description: The agent will turn your document into a structured action plan and ask to create a file
steps.command:
Read the uploaded document(s) in the uploads/ folder carefully. Create a file called 'action-plan.md' with these sections:

## Summary
A 2-3 sentence overview of what this document covers.

## Key Decisions
Bullet list of any decisions that were made or agreed upon.

## Action Items
A numbered list of concrete next steps. For each item include:
- What needs to be done
- Who is responsible (if mentioned)
- Any deadline or timeframe mentioned

## Open Questions
Anything that was raised but not resolved, or that needs follow-up.

Be specific — pull actual names, dates, and details from the document. Don't be generic.

steps.name: Review the action plan
steps.description:
1. Click Open on the action plan the agent just created
2. Click on lines to leave comments about what to change
3. Submit your feedback — the agent will revise the plan based on your notes

steps.name: Push action items to ClickUp
steps.description: In the same conversation, ask the agent to sync the action items to ClickUp
